chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 459: The Price of Revenge – Guilt & the Karmic Hellfire’s Victim
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning is teleported into a deathland. Mu Northson is crushed by guilt. And the man who killed billions to trap Ji Ning… survives the Karmic Hellfire. The aftermath begins.
og_title: The Karmic Hellfire Claims Its Price in Desolate Era Ch. 459
og_description: After Ji Ning’s explosive attack, the survivors flee in guilt as the Shaoyin clan’s true mastermind survives an impossible tribulation.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 459: The Most Bitter Victory
twitter_description: The villain who killed 100 billion mortals to trap Ji Ning just survived Karmic Hellfire. This is Xianxia karma at its most brutal.

lore_anchors.definition: A metaphysical flame born from immense karmic sin that burns a cultivator's soul and Dao-heart directly, bypassing all physical defenses. Surviving it transforms the Dao-heart into something terrifyingly resilient.
A localized, functional recreation of the original Six Paths of Reincarnation, established by Daofather Crimsonbright after the cosmic war shattered the original.
An artifact used by the Shaoyin clan's master to forcibly teleport Ji Ning into a deadly territory beyond the bounds of the Three Realms.
The administrative rulers of the Netherworld’s reincarnation courts, each overseeing a specific department of judgment for the dead.
The deepest and most painful layer of punishment in the Netherworld, reserved for souls bearing extreme sin before they can be eligible for reincarnation.
The Fiendgod Body Refining equivalent of a Celestial Immortal; a transcendent being with an immortal, indestructible divine body who has crossed the Heavenly Tribulation.

A cultivator whose physical body was destroyed during the Heavenly Tribulation, forcing them to survive as a soul-based immortal. They must endure periodic, increasingly deadly tribulations to cling to existence.
